title: Callsigns whose format does not fit the licence class (Ofcom FOI 01667041, not held)

relatedEntries.relation: the disclosure this request builds on: it cites 'your FOI response dated 21/08/23 reference 01649066' (the held 18 August 2023 register snapshot) and picks out M5SHA, listed there as a Foundation licence but carrying a Full-format callsign, as the example of a format-vs-class mismatch.

foi-01667041-licence-class-format-mismat.contentsIndicative: record-only Section 84 refusal: Ofcom does not record which issued callsigns have a format that does not match their licence class, and is not required to create that information to answer a request; the reply signposts the published amateur callsign allocation page. The request itself records the M5SHA observation (a Foundation licence carrying a Full-format callsign) and cites the 01649066 response of 21 August 2023.
